tariff_impact: Effect on net income from tariffs and import shipping costs was immaterial in the first nine months of 2026; company warns tariff exposure and import shipping costs may become more impactful in subsequent quarters as lower-tariff inventory is depleted and replaced with inventory subject to new and expanded tariffs.
steel_price_impact: Effect on net income from commodity steel prices was immaterial in the first nine months of 2026; no dollar figure given.
energy_price_impact: Effect on net income from commodity energy prices (fuel, utilities) was immaterial in the first nine months of 2026; effect of fossil-fuel feedstock costs on materials was also immaterial.
fx_exposure: Primary currency exposures are the Canadian dollar and the Mexican peso against the U.S. dollar. The dollar weakened in the first nine months of 2026 relative to other foreign currencies in which the company operates, but the effect on net income was immaterial. Company has not historically hedged foreign currency risk.
interest_rate_sensitivity: Loans under the Credit Facility bear interest at floating rates; company has not historically used interest rate swaps to hedge this exposure due to relatively small debt levels. A 100bp increase in floating rate debt would have resulted in approximately $0.1 of additional interest expense in the first nine months of 2026.
hedging_policy: No active hedging program disclosed. Company has not historically hedged foreign currency risk, and has not historically used interest rate swap arrangements to hedge variable interest rates under its Credit Facility given relatively small debt levels.
